report:
Fresh independent review of complete meta.reviews.gate after diagnostic-association and assertion updates. All four implementation associations (check.rs, review.rs, CLI main.rs::check, xtask::ci_test) and all nine associated tests are ordinary; there are no TODO/N/A deferrals. I consumed the fresh saved inputs, compared every fresh fragment against the previously inspected inputs (review.rs and xtask unchanged; check.rs/main.rs differ only by diagnostic associations), inspected all new associated test bodies, captured fixture helpers as lines 1-104 rather than the changing whole test file, and captured integration configuration and review contracts. Current complete claim requirements are accounted for; previous requested edits are resolved by the new direct tests and associations.

Implementation completeness: check_roots invokes check_reviews after valid source inventory. CheckReport::is_valid requires the review stage and ensure_valid turns any failure into a failing command/test. check_reviews calls current inventory, load_saved and validate; acceptable only counts a completed, current, edit-free report with nonempty tests and implementations. load_saved enumerates all directory entries, verifies valid IDs, real directory/file layout, summary identity and supported schema/policy versions, typed JSON format and nonblank output values. Completed summaries require output; incomplete summaries supply no output, so partial publication cannot pass. validate rejects missing, unfinished, edited, stale and association-mismatched records and either empty evidence collection. input_errors compares complete initial claim/test/implementation fragments and metadata, and resolves every additional selector for exact equality. validate examines both loaded records and load errors for absent IDs, reports the named validations directory with remove/reconcile/fresh-review guidance, and fails even if every current anchor passes. Checking only reads and locks existing state; record writes only the requested current anchor and does not prune obsolete IDs.

Integration completeness: captured .cargo/config.toml routes cargo meta to the CLI. Associated main.rs::check calls the shared check/check_model and ensure_valid. Associated xtask::ci_test invokes sage-meta check and workspace tests, and captured CI workflow invokes this xtask. Associated workspace test repository_docs_model_and_rust_correspond invokes the same check and ensure_valid directly. These are now automatic implementation/test inputs rather than uncoupled integration assumptions.

Complete test assessment: diagnostics_identify_missing_unfinished_stale_and_requested_edit_reviews asserts CLI failure for those four states, anchor/skill guidance, stale source-path context and edit context. incomplete_output_publication_never_satisfies_the_gate asserts output-before-recorded-summary, missing completed output and incomplete malformed output all fail. invalid_ids_and_paths_are_rejected_without_destroying_existing_reports asserts invalid/unknown starts and invalid reads preserve prior saved bytes/input. retired_records_fail_even_when_every_remaining_anchor_passes asserts obsolete-ID failure, named removal guidance, retained output and successful recovery only after explicit removal. unsupported_versions_and_mismatched_identity_cannot_pass independently corrupts each version and summary identity and asserts failure.

New completed_corrupt_records_and_invalid_layout_cannot_pass begins with a completed approval, then independently injects malformed output, blank reviewer/report/edit, an unknown output field, missing summary/input/output and a non-directory entry; both CLI and shared gate must fail. This closes the previous incomplete-only malformed-output gap. checking_is_read_only_and_recording_preserves_obsolete_records checks a missing review fails without creating validations, approved CLI/shared checks pass with identical three-file snapshots, a separate retired ID fails while both snapshots remain unchanged, and starting/recording the current ID preserves the retired snapshot and leaves the gate failing. This covers no approvals during checking, positive paths, and no silent obsolete cleanup by checking or recording. accepted_report_cannot_replace_missing_test_or_implementation_evidence removes each evidence kind from a previously approved fixture and asserts shared and CLI failures naming the anchor; combined with explicit nonempty checks and earlier structural source checks this establishes the stated requirement. Finally repository_docs_model_and_rust_correspond is the executable workspace shared-gate integration. Assertions are visible in test bodies; fixture helpers only create/load/write/run setup. The existing five tests plus these additions cover the complete claim without needing the previously suggested reuse associations.

Validation and execution: I ran cargo fmt --check successfully and performed the delegated post-codegen/sanity source review of the three new tests and annotation-only integration edits. No tokio mutex, unsafe code, inference variable construction or IR error construction occurs in those changed files; the new string dispatch matches are primitive patterns. No meaningful duplication, user-facing behavior change, architectural restructuring, exhaustiveness issue or comment hygiene issue was found. User-facing/architecture document checks are inapplicable to these test/association-only changes. I did not run functional tests or a build myself; coordinator reports 29 review tests passing, separately from this source assessment. Review start/read/record and the formatting check are my executed commands. No production bug was identified and no edits remain.

Final refresh delta assessment: started with /tmp/sage-refresh-6.txt and consumed current complete claim, all four implementation entries and all nine tests. Compared every fresh initial fragment with my previous review copies. The only implementation changes are review_diagnostics associations on CheckReport, its Display implementation, check_reviews and CLI check; executable gate behavior is unchanged. The gate metadata excerpt changes follow these added annotations and are present in the fresh inventory. Four test fragments changed: checking_is_read_only_and_recording_preserves_obsolete_records gained an additional diagnostic association only; diagnostics_identify_missing_unfinished_stale_and_requested_edit_reviews gained a record_required association and direct assertions for missing/unfinished reason strings; completed_corrupt_records_and_invalid_layout_cannot_pass gained a diagnostic association and now verifies CLI names the relevant directory, invalid-validation label, skill, and specific format/layout reason for every fault; unsupported_versions_and_mismatched_identity_cannot_pass now uses ensure_valid().unwrap_err() and asserts anchor, skill and version/identity reason, retaining the failure guarantee. These strengthen existing observable assertions and introduce no hidden helper behavior. Other initial fragments, including complete claim, tests and core review.rs, match the earlier inspected sources exactly. All relied-on fixture, Cargo alias, CI workflow, workspace test and normative review context were recaptured through read and verified unchanged. The earlier requirement-by-requirement implementation and all-nine-tests assessment therefore remains supported by the current captured sources. No source edits, new functional tests or formatting reruns were performed during this refresh; earlier formatting execution is explicitly historical. The coordinator now reports 331 sage-meta functional tests, 46 sage-stash tests and workspace build passing; those are reported results, not my executed commands. My commands for this refresh were start, recorded reads, saved-input comparisons and record. No requested edits or unresolved concerns remain.
